focus: A23 sk-vision OpenCode 2 runtime bugs: registration, grace, close(), interpreter checks, venv race
answeredQuestions: Which sk-vision OpenCode 2 runtime paths (registration, grace, close, interpreter checks, venv race) can still misbehave, and what fix does each need?

graphEvents.label: Which sk-vision OpenCode 2 runtime paths can still misbehave on OpenCode 2
Returned cleanup leaks registrations and client after a partial dispose failure
Guaranteed analysis downgrades to 2s grace when session.get fails
15s startup ping timer never cleared or unref'd
V2PluginContext contract unbacked by published v2 types
command.transform failure is fail-closed unlike tool registration

5s interpreter probes conflate slow with missing

label: Confirmed: createSetup's returned teardown awaits four disposals sequentially with no error isolation (plugin.ts:463); a prompt-hook dispose that throws skips the tool, command and auto-inspect disposals, leaking the 13 registered tools and the RuntimeClient child process. Phase 013 fixed this class only at setup time (the hook-registration catch uses Promise.allSettled). Fix: run the four disposals through Promise.allSettled and rethrow the first error; add a test where the prompt-hook dispose throws.

Inferred: the v2 prompt hook swallows a failed ctx.session.get into model=undefined (plugin.ts:417-421); isTextOnlyModel(undefined) is false (model-modality.ts:56), so a listed text-only model silently takes the 2s grace race (attachments.ts:96-101) instead of the guaranteed awaited run, and on a cold GPU receives no evidence at all — only the path note. The fail-open swallow is deliberate but converts the guarantee into best-effort with no signal, not even under SK_VISION_DEBUG=1. Fix: treat an unreadable model as the safe side (guaranteed=true when session.get is missing or throws) or emit a distinguishing DEBUG line.

Confirmed: spawn()'s startup ping races a bare setTimeout(resolve, 15000) (client.ts:354) with no reference held and no unref, so the timer keeps the host event loop alive up to 15s after construction — including after an earlier close() (client.ts:460) — and the abandoned ping entry stays in pending until the 120s default timeout (client.ts:90). Fix: hold and clear the timer when the race settles, and/or unref it.

Inferred: V2PluginContext is a hand-maintained contract (plugin.ts:109-137); the published @opencode-ai/plugin 1.17.15 v2 PluginContext declares only agent/aisdk/catalog/command/integration/plugin/reference/skill — no session, no tool domain — so correctness rests solely on the 2.0.32 live probe and every member access is optional-guarded. Any host-side rename degrades silently: a missing ctx.tool skips tool registration entirely (plugin.ts:449) and a missing session.get feeds f-iter001-002. Fix: feature-detect missing domains at setup with a SK_VISION_DEBUG=1 log; re-verify the contract on OpenCode version bumps.

Inferred: ctx.command.transform is awaited unguarded first in setup (plugin.ts:353); its rejection aborts the whole setup so the prompt hook, 13 tools and evidence injection never register — while the identical failure class in tool registration is deliberately fail-open (plugin.ts:454, 013 decision 4). Fix: wrap the command transform in the same try/catch + DEBUG log and continue.

Documented: a close() while mkdirAsync(venv) is in flight still creates the empty venv directory before the following throwIfClosed stops provisioning (client.ts:144-146); nothing installs or starts and the residue is an empty directory. Stands as phase 013 limitation 2; not unit-testable. Optional fix: best-effort removal of the empty venv directory on the closed path.

Inferred: hasMoondream and hasUv treat any failure of a 5s probe as not-installed (client.ts:213-224, 227-234); a cold-cache import exceeding 5s triggers unnecessary full venv provisioning and a genuinely broken interpreter's real error is discarded by the bare catch. Not v2-specific but sits under the v2 auto-inspect path. Fix: raise or make configurable the probe timeout; distinguish module-not-found from other failures via exit status/stderr.

note: bun test baseline in vision-runtime: 67 pass, 0 fail, 155 expect() calls, exit 0 — the registered paths (gate, ordering after the prompt hook, fail-open tools, toV2Tools mapping, close() kill/escalate, probe aborts) verified correct against code and suite.

No test throws from a prompt-hook dispose on the RETURNED cleanup path (only ctx.tool.transform and command-dispose throws at setup time are covered), and no test exercises the ctx.tool-absent branch (plugin.ts:449).
Phase 013 limitation 1 and 3 remain outside a read-only research run: no live run of the 2s grace path (decision 6) and no live rerun of the round-4 fixes (limitation 3).
